# Subway Seat for Obsidian

A full community theme: Walnut in dark mode, Enamel in light mode, and Tunnel as a Style Settings toggle or a CSS snippet. Headings run the 70s stripe from burnt orange to terracotta, and callouts, code, graph and canvas stay in the same warm room.

[Obsidian](https://obsidian.md) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/obsidian/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| All three | [`Subway Seat/manifest.json`](Subway%20Seat/manifest.json) | `<vault>/.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/manifest.json` |
| All three | [`Subway Seat/theme.css`](Subway%20Seat/theme.css) | `<vault>/.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/theme.css` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`snippets/subway-seat-tunnel.css`](snippets/subway-seat-tunnel.css) | `<vault>/.obsidian/snippets/subway-seat-tunnel.css` |

## Turn it on

In <vault>/.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/:

```text
Settings → Appearance → Themes → Subway Seat
Settings → Appearance → Base color scheme → Dark (Walnut) or Light (Enamel)
# Tunnel: Style Settings → Subway Seat → Tunnel, or turn on the subway-seat-tunnel snippet
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `<vault>/.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/manifest.json`.
- Delete `<vault>/.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/theme.css`.
- Delete `<vault>/.obsidian/snippets/subway-seat-tunnel.css`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
